trigger.description: How to reproduce, test and fix a reported bug in the pallets/click repository. Use when a prompt reports wrong behaviour in click (options, completion, prompts, help output).

steps.title: Reproduce the bug first
steps.text: **Reproduce the bug first.** Put the example from the report in `repro.py` at the repository root and run it with `.venv/bin/python repro.py`. Expect it to show the wrong behaviour.

expect.text: it to show the wrong behaviour

steps.title: Find the code
steps.text: **Find the code.** Search the package, for example `grep -rn "prompt_suffix" src/click`, and read the module that defines it.
steps.why_not: slot {symbol} is chosen by the agent (no stimulus binds it)

steps.title: Run the tests for that module
steps.text: **Run the tests for that module** with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_<module>.py -q`. Never use `python -m pytest`, `python3 -m pytest` or bare `pytest` instead of `.venv/bin/python -m pytest`: they fail with `No module named pytest`.

steps.title: Fix the code
steps.text: **Fix the code** in `src/click/<module>.py` and add a regression test to `tests/test_<module>.py`.
steps.why_not: no command: the step is the agent's judgment (an edit or a decision)

steps.title: After editing `src/click/*.py`, run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -x` to check the whole suite
steps.text: After editing `src/click/*.py`, run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -x` to check the whole suite. Expect `passed` and no failures.

steps.title: Before you finish
steps.text: **Before you finish**, run `.venv/bin/python repro.py` again to confirm the fix, then delete `repro.py`.

advice: Source lives in `src/click/`, tests in `tests/`, roughly one test file per module (`src/click/shell_completion.py` is tested by `tests/test_shell_completion.py`). The project's virtualenv `.venv` has click installed editable and pytest; the system Python has neither.
